mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDP indicates strong economic activity, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative when GDP growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment above 5% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns in 5 days.
failure_condition: Returns remain positive when unemployment exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Low FEDFUNDS and high UNRATE indicate economic stress, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Returns are negative despite low FEDFUNDS and high UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth during expansion signals strong supply, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Returns are negative despite industrial production growth.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained low FEDFUNDS eases monetary policy, boosting S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Returns are negative with low FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1200 indicate weak demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Returns are positive with HOUST below 1200.

mechanism_narrative: High RSAFS and low FEDFUNDS indicate strong demand and easing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns in 5 days.
failure_condition: Returns are positive despite high RSAFS and low FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment during recovery signals growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Returns are negative despite employment growth.
